Quotient Quest heroes

The heroes are now slimmer kid heroes with a fantasy look, in the redwood forest. Each option shows a fight and a row of 6 skins. Tap the options you like, then copy the codes and send them to Claude.

The game draws the health bars and the math buttons with code, so ignore small errors in that text.

H1

3D heroes in a painted forest

The characters need 3D models. We can also render the 3D models into sprite sheets for the 2D engine.

H2

Pixel heroes with soft light

This style works with the 2D engine as it is. Pixel sprites are fast to draw and animate.

H3

Full 3D fantasy world

The characters and the world need 3D models. This is the most work, but it gives the most polish.
